newsitem.title: UK: Mirror approach to MIN group rebuffed - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mirror approach to MIN group rebuffed - paper.

text.p: Mirror Group Plc, the newspapers to television combine, made a tenative approach to the biggest investor in Midland Independent Newspapers but was rebuffed, said the Daily Telegraph on Wednesday.

The report said the Mirror's brokers SBC Warburg made the approach to buy a stake last month to MIN's major shareholder Schroder Investment Management which holds 17 percent of shares in the independent newspaper group.

The offer was refused and both Schroder and SBC declined to comment in the report. No formal offer was ever tabled said the report and no talks were held between the boards of MIN and the Mirror Group.
